Firm has to design the EOT crane as per the site condition and re quirements. I. TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS FOR PROCUREMENT OF ELECTRIC OVE RHEAD TRAVELLING (EOT) CRANE OF CAPACITY 2 TON: A. TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS: 1) GENERAL: · Type of Crane: Single Girder EOT Crane · Quantity: 1 nos · Duty or Class of Crane (As per IS: 807 & IS: 3938) Mechanical Electrica l: M5 · Capacity of Crane: 2Ton · Deflection: Span/750 2) DIMENSIONAL DETAILS: · Span (Distance between centre of gantry Rails): 8.0 Meters · Height of Lift: 6.0 Meters · Side Clearance (Distance from centre of Track rail to nearest side obst ruction): 200mm · LT Rail (Recommended): 38 mm2 Sq. Bar · Bay Length: 12.0 Meters 3) CRANE PERFORMANCE: · Operating speeds: · Hoist: 3.0mpm ±10%

· Cross Travel: 13.0mpm ±10% · Long Travel: 13.0mpm ±10% · Creep speed: Through DOL for Hoist and CT, LT VFD only 4) CRANE CONTROLS: Pendant Push Button Stations & Remote Oper ation (Operated from floor level) 5) MECHANICAL DETAILS: a) WIRE ROPE: · Number of Falls: 4 · Wire rope Diameter: 10mm · Construction: 6 X 36 · Tensile Strength: 1960N/mm2 · Type of Core: Fibre Core · IS Specifications: IS: 2266 · Make: USHA MARTIN b) ROPE DRUM: Un-flanged Seamless Pipe c) GEAR BOXES · Type of Gear Boxes: Totally enclosed Helical/Spur · Material of Pinions: EN24 As per IS: 1570 · Material of Gears: EN9 As per IS: 1570 · Material of Gear Box body: M.S. Fabricated As per IS: 2062 · Type of Lubrication: Oil Splash d) WHEELS · Type: Double Flange Straight threads type · Material: C55 Mn75 As per IS: 1570 · Flanged Single / Double: Double Flange for LT/ Single for CT · Diameter of Wheels: · LT: Φ300mm X 4 No’s (Sizes are given only for reference)

· CT: Φ120mm X 4 No’s (Sizes are given only for reference) · Type of Bearings: SA Spherical Roller/Ball Bearing e) HOOKS: · Type: Plain ‘C’ Shank · IS Specification: IS: 3815 · Swivelling: Yes on Thrust Bearing · Safety Latch: Provided 6) STRUCTURAL DETAILS: a) MAIN BRIDGE GIRDERS: · Type: Fusion Welded Plate Box with intermediate Stiffeners · Material: IS: 2062 b) END CARRIAGE: · Type: Chanel and Plate Fabricated · Material: IS: 2062 c) PLATFORM: Four numbers short Platform for wheel Maintenance. d) BUFFERS: · LT: Steel Stopper · CT: Steel Buffer 7) ELECTRICAL DETAILS: a) MOTORS: All Motors are of Sq. Cage type/ IP55 Encl/ TEFC/ AC Indu ction with Class ‘B’ / ‘F’ Insulation.). · Main Hoist: 3HP X 1 No (Motor capacity are given only for reference) · CT: 0.5HP X 1 No (Motor capacity are given only for reference) · LT: 0.5HP X 2 No’s (Motor capacity are given only for reference)

b) BRAKES: · Type: EM AC Disc Brake · Main Hoist: ACEM Disc Brake (1No) · CT: N/A · LT: N/A c) LIMIT SWITCHES: · Main Hoist: Snap Action (2No,s) · CT: N/A · LT: Two Way Lever (1 No) d) CRANE CONTROLS: Panel for Hoist, CT & LT Drive will be provided which shall consist of HRC fuses Contactors, Relays, and Timers. e) CABLES: · Type: Multi core Copper · Insulation: PVC Sheathed Flexible · Minimum Size: 2.5 mm2 · For Power Circuit: 1.5 mm2 · For Control Circuit: f) POWER SUPPLY (MAIN): 415 V +/- 10%, 3 Phase, 50 Hz A.C. g) POWER SUPPLY CONTROL VOLTAGE: 110 V A.C. 8) PULLEY DIA: · Hoist: 150mm Dia. 9) DSL SYSTEM: · Long Travel: By means of PVC flexible festoon type Trailing Cable suit able for bay Length. · Cross Travel: By means of PVC flexible festoon type Trailing Cable suit

able for Span Length. 10) PAINTING: The crane will be thoroughly cleaned and two coats of Red oxide primer and two coats of synthetic Enamel paint. 11) WEIGHT DETAILS: (Only for reference) · Crane weight: 2.5Ton (Approx.) · Wheel base: 1,100mm · Wheel load: 2.1Ton (Without Impact) · Hook Approaches: 800mm · Cable looping: · Power Side: 500mm · Opp. Side: 500mm B. TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS (INDICATIVE): · Capacity: 2 Ton · Span: 8.0 Meters · Height of Lift: 6.0 Meters · Duty Class: M5 (As per IS:807 & IS: 3938) · Power Supply: 3 Phase, 415 V ±10%, 50 Hz · Control Voltage: 110 V/24 V AC/DC C. SCOPE OF SUPPLY: The contractor/vendor shall supply the following: 1) EOT Crane (2 Ton Capacity): · Single girder type · Electrically operated hoist and trolley · Runway beams and end carriages · Pendant control system and radio remote control · Long travel (LT), cross travel (CT), and hoisting mechanisms 2) Power Supply System: · DSL bus bar.

· Festoon cable system. · Required Electrical Panel. However IGMH will provide required Electrical power cable at the site. 3) Control Panel & Electrical Accessories: · Motors, brakes, contractors, VFDs (if required), cabling, and wiring 4) Safety Devices: · Limit switches (hoisting, CT, LT) · Railings, buffers, anti-collision devices · Overload protection system · Emergency stop switch D. INSTALLATION WORK: The vendor shall carry out complete installation, including: · Erection of girders, hoist, and trolley on the gantry or runway beams · Alignment and fitting of end carriages and rails. · Installation of power supply system, wiring, earthing, and controls · Fixing of control panel, limit switches, and safety devices · Structural integration and load path verification · Adherence to site safety requirements during installation · All Civil, Electrical and Mechanical work for installation is in Vendor's Scope. However IGMH will provide required Electrical supply at the site . E. TESTING AND COMMISSIONING: The vendor shall perform: · No-load and full-load testing · Load trial as per IS/IEC standards · Inspection of all movements: hoisting, CT, and LT · Functional check of safety systems and limit switches · Verification of alignment, brakes, and controls · Certification as per statutory norms (if applicable)

F. COMPLIANCE & STANDARDS: The crane and its components shall comply with the latest standard s. · IS 3177 / IS 807 · FEM / ISO / BIS standards · Factory Act and statutory safety guidelines G. WARRANTY & SUPPORT: · Minimum 12 months comprehensive warranty from commissioning dat e · Free rectification/replacement of faulty parts during warranty · Availability of after-sales support, spare parts, and maintenance servi ces H. TRAINING: The vendor shall provide: · Operational training to staff · Basic maintenance guidelines · Safety and emergency handling instructions I. DOCUMENTATION & HANDOVER: The vendor must submit OEM manuals, test certificates, technical d rawings and warranty documents along with the following: · Test reports and load testing certificates · Operation and maintenance manuals · Warranty certificates · As-built drawings ( Electrical, Mechanical and Civil) · Compliance certificates · Firm should submit the Structural design to be verified by reputable Govt. Institute i.e. IITs/NITs/ Regional Govt. Institutes etc. · While supplying the material firm has to submit manufacturer test cer tificates i.e. for Rope, MS Section, and Hoist etc. · MS Section Makes: Tata/Jindal/RINL/SAIL/SKS Ispat & Power preferabl y or equivalent.

PAYMENT TERM: 100% payment will be made within 30 days after successful issue of Fi nal Acceptance Certificate (FAC). III.
